primary: CIS 2022 PUMF household custom tabulation, household PUMFID; unique EFID family incomes summed once; household weights, unequivalised after-tax household cash income. No published vector exists for this custom household table. Official 11-10-0192 economic-family and 11-10-0193 adjusted-person deciles are separate crosschecks, not relabelled as household deciles.
cis_model_bridge: CIS subtracts income tax, but not loan interest or employee CPP/EI. Add back model net interest and employee SSC for a like-for-like cash comparison. DHEA cash DI remains separately reported.
